mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_PASSWORD AS userPassword, USER_NAME AS userName, USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, USER_EMAIL AS userEmail FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER ( USER_ID, USER_PASSWORD, USER_NAME, USER_NICKNAME, USER_EMAIL, USER_ROLE, USER_JOINDATE, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPassword}, #{userName}, #{userName}, #{userEmail}, 1, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
